collection.title: Citroen C8 2002 to 2005 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A Citroen C8 MPV 2002 to 2005 model requires a 26" wiper blade on both the drivers side and the passengers side with the Washer Jet fitting and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Standard Hook arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm. We also have the rear blade for this C8 MPV, simply click the Rear Blades tab below.
